milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting 4 sand in a 2x2 pattern produces 1 sandstone that ends up in the player's inventory. The scene contains no sandstone blocks or items, so this can only be satisfied by crafting. No position check needed since the recipe works in both the crafting table and the 2x2 inventory grid.

Uses inventory_has because crafting 4 nether quartz in a 2x2 pattern produces 1 quartz_block that ends up in the player's inventory. The scene contains no quartz blocks or items, so this can only be satisfied by crafting. No position check needed since the recipe works in both the crafting table and the 2x2 inventory grid.
